title: version/1: which build of mzlab-cli this is, `mzlab-cli --version --json`
description: The version and the git commit the binary was built from (MZLAB_COMMIT, else git at build time), with the citation. There is no build date, so two builds of one commit answer alike. `commit` is the full 40-character SHA, `commit_short` its first 7 characters; both are null for a build that knew no commit. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/citation.rs.
